summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, reporting share repurchases under a buyback program announced June 9, 2026. Between July 20-24, 2026, the company repurchased 95,670 ordinary shares at an average price of €25.41 per share, totaling €2.43 million. Repurchases were executed across multiple venues (Euronext Amsterdam, CEUX, AQEU, TQEX) through a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary. Post-repurchase, Lakefront holds 606,719 treasury shares. The program is open-market, not a tender offer. Watch for continued buyback execution and impact on EPS.
